root_causes: Windows visible desktop path was OneDrive desktop, not C:/Users/yasu/Desktop.
Windows saved RDP credentials/CredSSP caused GNOME RDP NTLM MIC verification failure.
GNOME Remote Desktop refused session creation while the local GNOME session was inhibited by lock/idle state.
lessons: For Ubuntu GNOME Wayland, try GNOME Remote Desktop RDP before Chrome Remote Desktop or x11vnc.
Always verify the actual Windows Desktop path with [Environment]::GetFolderPath('Desktop') before creating user-facing shortcuts.
Clear cmdkey saved TERMSRV credentials when GNOME RDP shows NTLM MIC verification failures.
If GNOME RDP logs Session creation inhibited, unlock the local session and disable screen lock/idle lock temporarily before retrying.
Keep SSH as the recovery path and create rollback scripts before changing remote desktop state.
safety_notes: Chrome Remote Desktop was not installed.
GDM, GRUB, and system display manager configs were not modified.
No sudo-required package installation was performed.
